title: Grilled Chicken Biryani
description: A flavorful and aromatic biryani dish made with marinated grilled chicken, served with a side of yogurt sauce.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add cumin powder, coriander powder, and garam masala. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the marinated chicken and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 10-12 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Meanwhile, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a separate pan.
Add the chopped cilantro and cook for 1 minute.
Add the uncooked basmati rice and cook for 2-3 minutes or until lightly toasted.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 10-12 minutes or until the rice is cooked and fluffy.
To assemble the biryani, place a layer of cooked rice, then a layer of chicken, and repeat until all the ingredients are used up.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve with a side of yogurt sauce.
To make the yogurt sauce, mix together 1/2 cup of marinated russian yogurt with 1 tablespoon of chopped cilantro and 1 tablespoon of lemon juice.
